## Purpose

Describe the user/scientific need and the smallest implemented change.

## Contract impact

- [ ] No public/scientific contract change
- [ ] Public contract/model version updated and documented
- [ ] Experimental/internal only

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 tests/run_unit_tests.py`
- [ ] `nextflow lint .`

List exact commands, results, skips and environmental blockers.

## Scientific review

Explain algorithm, default, threshold, statistical or interpretation changes.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private data, caches or large generated artifacts

- [ ] No release tag was created
